reopened_reason: The complete verified EW-RS-071 orientation ladder, HVD restriction tests, cross-k comparison, and deterministic shuffle controls are now available beyond the preflight-only geometric falsifier.

new_assertions.body: Diagonal slope sign is exactly quotientable for reflection-invariant scalar questions because horizontal reflection preserves H/V, exchanges D+/D-, and commutes with q_o/RFG, T2, exact componentization, and ROLE_CAPPAR aggregation on the declared carriers.
The strong H/V/D source hypothesis is rejected twice: 6x3-k4 has no V or D geometry while retaining the full non-HVD OOO scalar image, and HVD-only residue is not scalar-exact on 4x5-k4.

No declared compressed orientation summary is a common scalar-exact carrier across 6x3-k3, 4x5-k4, and 6x3-k4. Common exactness appears only at exact orientation-provenance/reconstruction granularity.

Exact orientation provenance does not demonstrate orientation necessity: deterministic cyclic reassignment of descriptor orientation annotations preserves exactness at that granularity on every carrier and can make several coarser summaries exact where the true orientation assignment fails.

The clean same-geometry 6x3 k=3 versus k=4 comparison has no shared scalar-exact compressed orientation-feature vocabulary; therefore persistence of OOO across k cannot be explained by a shared H/V/D motif law under EW-RS-071.

The non-orientation EW-RS-069 exact pair-delta exchange carrier is the stronger common structural explanation candidate: it is scalar-exact on all three hard carriers and has lower image rank than exact orientation provenance on 4x5-k4.

After EW-RS-071, orientation provenance should remain a carrier-specific diagnostic rather than the primary common-syndrome search axis. The next common-law search returns to support/exchange coordinates, beginning with the frozen EW-RS-070 pair-delta compression ladder.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed; no orientation result authorizes formula-holdout access.
